checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add melodic interval analysis

impact_assessment.why: stats reports pitch range and density but not the melodic contour between consecutive notes, which is useful for theory analysis.
impact_assessment.benefits: intervals prints a deterministic signed semitone sequence with extremes and up/down/level counts for any score.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rests skipped, signed steps exact, empty and single-note scores handled, deterministic formatting; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests pinning the full report for known melodies, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 391 tests green; step sequences, rest handling and single-note output pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-intervals' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add WAV region reversal

impact_assessment.why: reverse-wav flips an entire file, but reversing only a selected time span requires an external editor.
impact_assessment.benefits: reverse-region reverses frames inside an exact time window, leaving the head and tail byte-identical and preserving rate and length.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: 0 <= start < end finite, frame rounding exact, head/tail unchanged, out-of-range windows handled, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for middle/full windows, identity cases and validation, a CLI command reusing --start/--end, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 396 tests green; window reversal, head/tail preservation and validation pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-reverse-region' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add WAV repetition

impact_assessment.why: loop repeats a score but there is no way to repeat an already-processed WAV into a seamless loop.
impact_assessment.benefits: repeat-wav appends the source WAV N times with untouched audio bytes and unchanged sample rate; N=1 is byte-identical.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: N >= 1, bounded upper limit, frame count scales exactly, sample rate preserved, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for identity, exact tiling and validation, a CLI command reusing --times, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 400 tests green; exact tiling, frame scaling and count validation pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-repeat-wav' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: c79260f1fc994de072d9450e4db959e79960a17a

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add crossfading of two WAVs

impact_assessment.why: join crossfades scores before rendering, but there is no way to crossfade two already-rendered WAVs.
impact_assessment.benefits: crossfade overlaps the tail of one WAV with the head of another over an exact duration using deterministic linear gains.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rates must match, overlap rounded to frames and bounded by both lengths, zero overlap is plain concatenation, output clamped, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for zero overlap, exact midpoint blending and length, a two-WAV CLI command with --crossfade, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 405 tests green; zero-overlap, midpoint blending and length preservation pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-crossfade' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: 747d9dc15b183784ba7166ebe9b4bb936fd9995e

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a brick-wall WAV limiter

impact_assessment.why: gain trims a whole file and distort saturates smoothly, but there is no hard ceiling that caps every sample at a chosen level.
impact_assessment.benefits: limit clamps each sample to a symmetric threshold, preserving rate and length, with full-scale identity on ordinary signals.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: limit 0..1, all samples bounded, deterministic, full-scale identity on normal input, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for identity, clamping, determinism and validation, a CLI command with --limit, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 409 tests green; full-scale identity, exact capping and determinism pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-limit' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: eb4a1ebf80de641ce84b1211930cb81f5e3bd03c

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add transposed phrase sequencing

impact_assessment.why: loop repeats exactly and transpose shifts once, but building a sequence of transposed repetitions needs both operations manually.
impact_assessment.benefits: sequence appends one transposed copy per requested semitone shift at successive phrase offsets, preserving rhythm and timbre as canonical source.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: shifts non-empty and bounded, offsets exact, out-of-range pitches skipped, output round-trips, invalid input fails; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for offsets, transposition, preservation and round-trip, a CLI command with --shifts, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 414 tests green; offsets, transposition, exact repeats and round-trip pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-sequence' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add mid/side stereo transform

impact_assessment.why: channels and width can fold or widen stereo but cannot store a stereo image as mid and side components for processing.
impact_assessment.benefits: midside encodes a stereo pair into mid/side and decodes it back, with exact mono-to-side-zero behaviour and a bounded round-trip.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: mode encode/decode, mono input yields zero side, mid-only decodes to dual mono, round-trip within quantization, invalid inputs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for encode, decode, round-trip and validation, a CLI command reusing --mode, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 419 tests green; mono-to-side, mid-only and bounded round-trip pinned by byte tests
